name: protein_secondary
description: A protein secondary-structure strip (textbook shorthand): the chain drawn N → C left to right, α-helices as coils, β-strands as block arrows, loops as thin curves. Choose this scene for requests about protein structure, α-helix vs β-sheet, secondary structure, or explaining how a protein chain folds into structural elements. Accepts either an explicit segment list or a compact ss string of H/E/C runs (H = helix, E = strand, C = coil/loop).

segments.description: Explicit segments, left to right. Alternate loops between structural elements.

ss.description: Compact alternative: e.g. "CCHHHHHCCEEEECC". Runs become segments; first helix/strand get labeled automatically.

element_ids.seg_<i>: segment i (helix coil / strand arrow / loop curve)
element_ids.n_term / c_term: the N and C terminus letters

examples.request: Show a protein with an alpha helix and a beta strand.
